$comment: INERT planning example. Not registered, not loaded, not wired into any code. A complete, plausible PluginManifest for a FUTURE Cloudflare R2 backup/sync plugin, mirroring the marketplace contract (crates/server/src/plugins/manifest.rs). This plugin would carry a native backend_entry because durable writes and credentials live behind the Rust server (the only durable writer). Field names stay English (marketplace surface); host PROJECTUS domain identifiers (revision, criado_em, atualizado_em, arquivo) are untouched.
title: Cloudflare R2 Backup
short_description: Encrypted off-site backup and snapshots to Cloudflare R2 object storage.
long_description: Cloudflare R2 Backup pushes full, integral snapshots of your PROJECTUS data to an R2 bucket using S3-compatible APIs. It schedules background backup jobs, stores R2 access credentials in the host secret store (never in plaintext), and verifies every uploaded object with a SHA-256 digest (never MD5). Snapshots preserve the host revision and criado_em / atualizado_em metadata so a restore is faithful. A settings panel configures the bucket, endpoint, schedule and retention; the backup subsystem integration triggers on demand or on a timer. The Rust backend remains the only durable writer: this plugin's backend_entry brokers the actual transfers and credential access.
